skill_name: Summarize the reasons for the increasing popularity of online streaming services
workflow: Online streaming services have become increasingly popular due to the convenience and wider selection of content available. These services allow users to quickly access their favorite movies, TV shows, and other video content without the need for downloading or waiting for a physical copy of the media.
